messages:
Jules M: Quick sync: We're targeting the console analytics schema change for route metrics next Wednesday. Plan is: start dual-write, run parity probes, then flip read shim. Need volunteers for probe dashboard and rollback playbook.
Priya S: I can take probe dashboard. Suggestion: keep the quota contract stable—don't change quota_window representation in this pass. We'll treat quota_window -> quota_windows as a follow-up.
Jules M: Agreed. Smaller blast radius. We'll only compact the metrics payload (rename fields, drop legacy tags) and expose a readshim that implements old field names.
Omar N: Backfill approach idea: streaming shadow writes for live data + partitioned historical copy for older ranges. Use checkpointing to resume. We'll annotate rows with _migrated boolean to prevent duplication.
DevOps Bot: scheduler: analytics.backfill_stream started for partition 2026-03-20T04:00Z -> chunk-size=5k/concurrency=6.
Priya S: Probe queries I want on the dashboard: per-route counts, p50/p95/p99 latency diffs, unique-user counts, and sample payload diffs for 12 routes. If any metric differs >1.5% or p99 > 10% we pause.
Jules M: Good thresholds. Add an alert: readshim_latency_delta > 15% for 10m -> paging. Also automated rollback if parity fails during the canary.
Omar N: SQL snippets for probes (run hourly):
```
-- hourly parity probe
SELECT r.route_id,
  old.cnt as old_count,
  new.cnt as new_count,
  abs(old.cnt - new.cnt)::float / nullif(old.cnt,1) as pct_diff,
  old.p99 as old_p99, new.p99 as new_p99
FROM (
  SELECT route_id, count(*) as cnt, percentile_disc(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p99
  FROM analytics.route_metrics_v1
  WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
  GROUP BY route_id
) old
JOIN (
  SELECT route_id, count(*) as cnt, percentile_disc(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) as p99
  FROM analytics.compact_route_metrics_v2
  WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
  GROUP BY route_id
) new USING (route_id)
WHERE abs(old.cnt - new.cnt) > 0 OR abs(old.p99 - new.p99) / nullif(old.p99,1) > 0.15
LIMIT 300;
```
Priya S: Also include a lightweight row-level checksum for a few routes to validate JSON payload shape: md5(payload::text).
Lina (UX): Console change notes: until readshim is live, UI should keep showing "metrics source: legacy". After flip, show "metrics source: compact_v2" and a freshness banner if the backfill is > 6h behind. Add user-facing FAQs.
Jules M: Rollout steps I'm tracking: 1) deploy dual-write toggle and enable for 5% traffic for 24h; 2) start shadow backfill for recent 30d; 3) validate probes; 4) increase dual-write to 50% for 48h; 5) flip readshim for canary orgs; 6) if all good, flip for everyone and start historical partition migration.
Omar N: Rollback: flip the dual-write off, disable readshim alias, mark unfinished backfill partitions as 'paused' with resume token. Backfill workers must honor tombstones so we don't resurrect deleted rows.
DevOps Bot: job-note: backfill workers will write resume_token to analytics.backfill_state. Concurrency governor set to prevent more than 6 simultaneous partitions.
Priya S: One more thing: add a console_view in schema `console_compat` that maps compact_v2 fields -> old names using simple COALESCEs for missing fields so the frontend doesn't see nulls. We'll remove view after quota change is done.
Jules M: Thanks. Priya, please add the probe dashboard (link it here). Omar, add the resume-token column and tombstone handling to the backfill job. I'll create the 5% feature flag and coordinate with SRE for on-call during flip.
Priya S: Will do. Sending initial probe dashboard link in 30m. :rocket:
Lina (UX): I'll draft the banner copy and FAQ PR.
Omar N: I'll add backfill changes and test locally tomorrow.
Jules M: Great. Meeting adjourned. Ping here with any blockers. :white_check_mark:
